+"""The DepthExceededError error and its helper."""
+
+from lamina.errors import LaminaError
+
+
+class DepthExceededError(LaminaError):
+    """Raised for depth exceeded problems."""
+
+
+def raise_depth_exceeded(message: str, line: int, column: int, *, skip: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
+    """Raise DepthExceededError for message at line and column."""
+    skip = list(skip or [])
+    skip.append(message)
+    full_message = message if message.endswith(".") else message + "."
+    if line < 1:
+        raise DepthExceededError(full_message, 1, max(column, 1))
+    raise DepthExceededError(full_message, line, column)
